OPERATIVE NOTE Date of surgery: 05/23/2067 Patient: FROST, A Procedure: Primary low transverse cesarean section after augmentation of labor Surgeon: Dr. Okonjo Assistant: R. Kapoor (resident) Anaesthesia: Dr. Li, epidural converted to spinal/epidural top-up Pre-op dx: Failure to progress, term pregnancy. Post-op dx: same.
Indications: arrest of dilation at 6 cm for 4 hrs despite adequate contractions on oxytocin. Risks discussed, consent signed by patient with partner Dev present.
Findings: Live infant, wt 3.4 kg, Apgars 8 and 9. Clear fluid. Normal uterus, tubes and ovaries.
Description: Pt supine w/ left tilt, prepped and draped. Pfannenstiel incision. Uterus incised transversely, infant delivered vertex, cord clamped, cord blood sent. Placenta delivered intact. Uterus closed in 2 layers, fascia closed w/ running suture, skin w/ subcuticular. Counts correct x2. EBL 600 mL. Pt to recovery stable.
Post-op: the baby is called "Baby Girl Frost" on the band but mom says his name is Ocean. (Baby is a boy -- band corrected.)
Dictated by Pilar Okonjo, MD. "Pillar Okonjo" in the header was an autocorrect, ignore. Signed 05/23/2067.
